lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: nominative feminine dual (form XI) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ is in the derivative form: مُدْهَامَّتَانِ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/هـ/م   d–h–m blackness, dark green; large numbers of people; attack, to overtake, to overwhelm, calamity. Of this root, مُدْهَامَّتَانِ mudhāmmatān occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُدْهَامَّتَانِ mudhāmmatān [dual of fem. act. part. (of v. IX) مُدْهَامَّة mudhāmmatun] blackish green, very dark green

(55:62–4) وَمِنْ دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَان ... مُدْهَامَّتَانِ there are two other gardens below these two … both of deepest green.
